answer: The main difference between Naive RAG and Graph RAG in handling document chunks is that Naive RAG processes documents as a collection of independent chunks, which may result in fragmented and less coherent responses. In contrast, Graph RAG constructs knowledge graphs from related and unrelated data and their relationships, enabling a deeper level of interpretation and more coherent and accurate answers by retrieving information based on relationships between entities rather than just semantic similarity. This allows Graph RAG to perform multi-hop retrieval and provide more contextually rich responses.
